reason: PR #397 implements server-owned 9-tier sponsorship pricing, verified payer capture, campaign creation, advertiser intake, safe auto-publication, live placement delivery, D1 impression/click tracking, private reports, report/renewal/final-report generation and automatic expiry. Worker tests and wrangler deploy --dry-run passed. Deploy the Worker revision from PR #397 or its final merged equivalent without changing existing PayPal or Cloudflare secrets.

Only after those checks, merge/deploy the matching COSHUMA frontend changes.

Do not rotate or expose PayPal/Cloudflare secrets.
